title: IntentVLA: Short-Horizon Intent Modeling for Aliased Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2605.14712v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robot imitation data are often multimodal: similar visual-language observations may be followed by different action chunks because human demonstrators act with different short-horizon intents, task phases, or recent context. Existing frame-conditioned VLA policies infer each chunk from the current observation and instruction alone, so under partial observability they may resample different intents across adjacent replanning steps, leading to inter-chunk conflict and unstable execution. We introduce IntentVLA, a history-conditioned VLA framework that encodes recent visual observations into a compact short-horizon intent representation and uses it to condition chunk generation. We further introduce AliasBench, a 12-task ambiguity-aware benchmark on RoboTwin2 with matched training data and evaluation environments that isolate short-horizon observation aliasing. Across AliasBench, SimplerEnv, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, IntentVLA improve

translated_title: IntentVLA：面向混叠机器人操作的短时程意图建模
translated_abstract: 机器人模仿数据往往是多模态的：相似的视觉-语言观测之后可能跟随不同的动作块，因为人类演示者会基于不同的短时程意图、任务阶段或近期上下文采取不同的行动。现有的基于单帧条件的VLA策略仅从当前观测和指令来推断每个动作块，因此在部分可观测条件下，它们可能在相邻的重规划步骤中重新采样出不同的意图，导致动作块之间的冲突和不稳定的执行。我们提出IntentVLA，这是一个基于历史条件的VLA框架，它将近期视觉观测编码为紧凑的短时程意图表示，并用该表示来条件化动作块的生成。我们进一步提出AliasBench，这是一个构建在RoboTwin2上的包含12个任务的模糊感知基准，其训练数据与评估环境相匹配，能够隔离短时程观测混叠问题。在AliasBench、SimplerEnv、LIBERO和RoboCasa上，IntentVLA提升了……
tldr: IntentVLA通过将近期视觉观测编码为紧凑的短时程意图表示来条件化动作块生成，解决了相似观测下多模态动作采样导致的动作块冲突与执行不稳定问题，并提出了专门隔离观测混叠问题的AliasBench基准。
en_tdlr: IntentVLA conditions action chunk generation on a compact short-horizon intent representation encoded from recent visual observations, resolving inter-chunk conflicts and unstable execution caused by multimodal action sampling under observation aliasing, and introduces the AliasBench benchmark to isolate short-horizon observation aliasing.
